0022600167.text: The Houston Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home, W1 streak) host the Boston Celtics (4-1, 4-0 at home, W4 streak) as they sit second in the Southwest, half a game behind the division leader, and second in the West, while Boston is third in the East and one game back in the Atlantic. Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, and Fred VanVleet (knee) and Reed Sheppard (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams have not yet met this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on February 4, 2026, in Houston, where the Rockets lost 114-93.
